name: Harlan Needs a Resupply
summary: Harlan Bagley, a merchant in Stormwind, finds his racks emptied by an unprecedented surge in demand for sturdy garments and armor. Unaware of the brewing conflicts beyond the city walls, he dispatches a courier with an urgent cloth order to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop.

sections.title: A Run on Sturdy Clothes
sections.body: In the bustling commercial districts of Stormwind City, shopkeepers like Harlan Bagley have seen their inventory dwindle at an alarming rate. Ordinary citizens and wandering adventurers alike have been snatching up reinforced tunics, traveling wear, and battle-ready armor. To Harlan, it feels as though the kingdom's populace is bracing for a harsh season or an impending winter, but the sheer volume of sales leaves his shop depleted and desperate for finished cloth.

sections.title: Questions on the Canals
sections.body: To replenish his shelves, Bagley sends a runner across the city's waterways to Rema Schneider, the seamstress operating the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. While Rema is grateful for the continued trade, the sudden run on protective outfitting strikes her as unsettling. Rumors of tension linger throughout the kingdom, and the seamstress cannot help but wonder if Stormwind's ruling House of Nobles is hiding rumors of an open war from the common folk.

faq.answer: Harlan Bagley is a clothier and shopkeeper operating in Stormwind City. His business relies on local tailors to keep his inventory stocked with knitted goods and travel-ready garments.

Rema Schneider is a professional tailor and seamstress who works at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop in Stormwind. Along with her husband Corbett, she supplies merchants across the city with freshly sewn fabric and garments.

faq.q: Why is Harlan running out of clothing?
faq.answer: Citizens and travelers have been buying up armor and rugged garments in unusually high numbers. Harlan jokes that people act as if a bitter winter is coming, though the true cause is the rising unrest and danger across the kingdom's borders.

faq.q: Why does Rema Schneider suspect the nobles?
faq.answer: Rema finds it unnatural that common folk are suddenly equipping themselves for battle without any official declaration of conflict. Since the House of Nobles controls royal affairs while King Varian Wrynn remains absent, she fears the aristocracy is concealing impending war from the public.

faq.q: Where is the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop located?
faq.answer: The Canal Tailor and Fit Shop sits along the waterways that wind through Stormwind City, tucked conveniently between the major urban districts for easy merchant delivery.

faq.q: What happens after the cloth request is delivered?
faq.answer: Upon receiving the order, Rema prepares the supply request, prompting her husband Corbett Schneider to set out through the city streets—passing local storefronts like the Lionheart Armory and Trias' Cheese—to handle trade errands.

angles.text: The errand offers a glimpse into the everyday logistics of Stormwind's textile industry, where small canal workshops supply larger mercantile storefronts.
The quiet panic among Stormwind's shoppers hints at the growing unease gripping the Alliance heartland in the absence of King Varian Wrynn.
Stormwind's working-class artisans remain wary of their rulers, suspecting the nobility of keeping ordinary citizens in the dark about looming dangers.
